records.selection_method: One verified representative per observed color set; other discovery hits remain in raw captures and are not classified as exclusions. This is positive-access evidence, not an exhaustive census.

card_review.name: Adaptive Armorer
card_review.inclusion_reason: Adaptive Armorer drafts from its spellbook onto the battlefield when it enters; an Equipment entering this way attaches to a creature you control.

card_facts.name: Adaptive Armorer
card_facts.oracle_text:
Vigilance
When this creature enters, draft a card from Adaptive Armorer's spellbook and put it onto the battlefield. When an Equipment enters this way, attach it to target creature you control.
